title: Core colors
slide_intent: Teach designers to consider the relative area and foreground treatment of a palette. A sheet of colors can guide emphasis as well as hue selection.
strategic_value: Slack can use white, black and aubergine for larger areas while the four symbol colors supply recognizable accents.
demonstration: Three large swatches occupy the upper row. Four smaller accent swatches form the row beneath. Each field displays its color specifications in the prescribed black or white text.
practical_value: Use the areas of the specimens to compare core and accent roles, then retain the text color shown on the chosen ground.

content_islands.name: Page heading
content_islands.spec: Place the small bold title at upper left above a horizontal rule spanning the page.

content_islands.name: Proportion and text guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the two usage paragraphs at left, covering relative area and the foreground specified for each swatch.

content_islands.name: Core fields and accent strip
content_islands.spec: Use three tall fields for White, Black and Aubergine above a shorter row of Blue, Green, Yellow and Red. Align the rows to the same outer edges and put reproduction values inside each field.

content_islands.name: Running footer
content_islands.spec: Below a thin rule at the foot, align the folio, book title and Design elements section label.
